bio.text: Cathy Giessel has served in the Alaska Senate for District E since 2011, was Senate President from 2019 to 2020, and is listed as Senate Majority Leader for 2023 to 2026.
Giessel's legislative biography says Giessel was born in Fairbanks and is a registered nurse and advanced nurse practitioner.
It lists a B.S. in nursing from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, and an M.S. in nursing from the University of Alaska Anchorage.
